inputs.counterbalance: For every workload Q baseline→candidate, ordinary candidate→baseline; sequential processes only, one pass, no warmup/repeat sweep. Descriptive pair, not statistical significance.
launch_conditions: Principal records separate learned-artifact projection after frozen dialogue pair releases the sole model slot.
Recheck exact binary/request/bundle bindings, free memory/reserve and existing cumulative/phase limits before launch.
No model process overlap; no artifact repacking, tokenizer changes, deletions, retries or quality-driven request changes.

comparison.replay: Join each mode by block_index/position_in_block/input_token; compare all deterministic row fields including actual distribution and state SHA, predictions and mass/slot invariants; exclude only model_step_ns. Historical equality is distinct from new baseline/candidate equality.
comparison.generation: Compare every generation field exactly except model_step_nanoseconds and whole_generation_nanoseconds; summaries have separately comparable counts/bindings, not byte equality.
comparison.chat: Require zero process exit, two snapshots, no printed error; compare complete parsed session DTO and visible assistant output after removing terminal formatting/telemetry/path-bearing save acknowledgements. Token histories and sampler state are authoritative deterministic outputs. Existing CLI omits stream.error/stop and per-step probability hashes: no claim covering these omitted observations or save-load-resume.
comparison.cost: Capture external complete process wall including load/tokenizer/I/O/seal where CLI performs sealing, maximum child RSS and explicit sampled group RSS, and existing nested model times/call counts. Do not add nested clocks to wall or equate generated tokens with model calls. Ordinary source/continuation report load separately; replay models include full attention window.
comparison.failures: Preserve failed reports; stop on execution/incomplete/identity mismatch. A complete sealed legacy replay mismatch needs principal interpretation as baseline-history versus candidate arithmetic, not an automatic retry/tuning programme.

estimates.expected_wall: Approximately 70–120 seconds for 12 ordinary commands plus four short chat processes; historical source/backend/load differs, so this is an estimate. 600s proposed phase cap includes orchestration/derived comparison and stop margin.
unknowns: Current baseline and candidate learned-artifact latency/RSS and probability equality are unmeasured.
Historical resource peaks are sampled combined RSS for two concurrent processes, not per-process maximum RSS.
No retained real-artifact uor-chat process receipt supplies a comparable cost estimate; console telemetry excludes some work and has no distribution/stop recorder.
No width128 learned bundle is selected: width128 has focused arithmetic coverage only; these actual outputs cover width256 Quaternion and HouseholderPair.
No physical DRAM traffic or energy measurement; coefficient byte reduction remains representation accounting.

inspection.method: Read-only JSON, file inventory/size/SHA256/BLAKE3 inspection using existing Python blake3. No Rust binary invoked, model loaded or forward executed.
